changelog:
### UI Improvement — DNS Result Modal
- DNS results now show in a full modal popup instead of inline panel
- Mobile: bottom-sheet slide-up animation
- Desktop: centered dialog with blurred backdrop
- Color-coded header icon and status bar (healthy/warning/error)
- MX record strip
- Per-check rows: dot icon, pill label (PASS/WARN/FAIL/SKIP), check name, detail
- Verify All shows per-domain summary in same modal
- Close on X button, footer Close button, backdrop click, or Escape key
